toegepas.na: So het albei kante iets gekry
toegepas.rede_vinder: Only one party (the family) is named before 'albei', so 'albei kante' makes clear it means both sides of the trade; adds one short everyday word and replaces nothing.
toegepas.fout: 'albei' has only one named party before it (the family); the other side of the trade is implied, so a Grade 5 reader has to work out who 'albei' are.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'albei kante' is the natural Afrikaans way to name both sides of a trade, it fixes the missing referent without changing who did what, and one added two-syllable word in a text averaging 1.51 moves the syllables-per-word figure by only about 0.003, which keeps it under the 1.52 ceiling.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Nie elke plek het alles nie
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Op party plekke het daar yster of koper in die klippe gesit.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Op party plekke was daar yster of koper in die klippe.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'het daar ... gesit' is colloquial and wooden for metal in rock; 'was daar' is the natural, simpler construction.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Daar sit yster in die klippe' is natural, idiomatic Afrikaans for ore in rock; 'was daar' is only a different way of saying it.
